summary: Upright (acoustic) bass: woody, plucked, jazz and bossa nova
label: upright bass
body: Walking lines in jazz, roots and fifths in bossa nova; under a lofi or boom-bap beat it reads as sampled jazz.

Register: MIDI 28-50 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Acoustic Bass, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Acoustic Bass") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
